newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark wins North Sea cable order.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark wins North Sea cable order.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark A/S said on Tuesday it secured a 100 million crown order from Belgium-based Hermes Europe Railtel for two undersea cable systems with onland cable link-up between the Netherlands and Belgium and England.
It said the total length of the cable system would be 325 km (200 miles), with Denmark's DSC Communications A/S responsible for making the cables and Tele Danmark for laying them in the North Sea.
It said the system was due to go on line in 1997's third quarter.

Hermes Europe Railtel is a joint venture involving U.S. telecoms firm GTS Inc. and eleven national European rail networks on a 50-50 basis in a project in which fibre optic cables are being laid along railway lines.
Tele Danmark said the rail-cable network, which is to link 16 west and central European countries, was scheduled to be completed by mid-1999.
